subject.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events

question: Should gateway final and aborted chat events officially expose the persisted assistant transcript ID as the supported external run-output and deduplication contract?
rationale: The implementation is additive and mechanically plausible, but integrations may permanently depend on when this identity is present and what terminal output it represents; that API semantic requires gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt with defined semantics
options.body: Approve the optional field after persistence-backed edge-case tests and redacted live event-to-transcript correlation proof.

options.title: Use a separate lookup
options.body: Provide an explicit run-output correlation API if terminal chat events should not carry transcript identity.

recommendation.title: Adopt with defined semantics
recommendation.body: Approve the optional field after persistence-backed edge-case tests and redacted live event-to-transcript correlation proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest focused history across gateway chat routing, history projection, control replies, and the original chat injection surface.
